Ionic liquid [BMIM+][TFSI−], 0.1 M TBATF6 in CH3CN solution, 0.1 M TBATF6 in CH3CN solution containing 1 mM redox-active monomers, or 0.1 M TBATF6 in CH2Cl2 and THF (1:1) solution containing redox-active polymers (2.5 mg/mL) were prepared as electrolytes.

Ionic liquid [BMIM+][TFSI−], 0.1 M TBATF6 in CH3CN solution, 0.1 M TBATF6 in CH3CN solution containing 1 mM redox-active monomers, or 0.1 M TBATF6 in CH2Cl2 and THF (1:1) solution containing redox-active polymers (2.5 mg/mL) were prepared as electrolytes.
ΔG was calculated with a virtual electrolyte ε = 10.

measurements.quote: two reversible redox waves were observed at E1/2 = −1.25 and −1.7 V versus Ag/AgNO3 under N2
two reversible redox waves were observed at E1/2 = −1.25 and −1.7 V versus Ag/AgNO3 under N2
only one reversible redox wave was detected at E1/2 = −1.2 V versus Ag/AgNO3 under CO2
a reversible redox reaction of BTZ (BTZ + e−↔BTZ• −) occurs at E1/2 = −1.8 V versus Ag/AgNO3
The reduction potential of BTZ under CO2 is −1.8 V versus Ag/AgNO3
The CV of PAQ shows two reversible redox waves at E1/2 = −1.25 and −1.4 V versus Ag/AgNO3 under N2
The CV of PAQ shows two reversible redox waves at E1/2 = −1.25 and −1.4 V versus Ag/AgNO3 under N2
Under CO2, the waveform of PAQ shows two reduction waves (−1.2 and −1.35 V)
Under CO2, the waveform of PAQ shows two reduction waves (−1.2 and −1.35 V)
The reduction potential of PBTZ under N2 is detected at −2.05 V
The ΔG values of AQ−CO2− and AQ−(CO2−)2 were calculated to be 15.1 and −7.3 kJ/mol at ε = 10, respectively.
ΔG of BTZ−(CO2−)2 formation at ε = 10 was calculated to be −36.3 kJ/mol

observations.quote: suggesting that the adsorption mode of reduced AQ with CO2 is physisorption.
indicating that such a weak adsorption is favorable for the electro-swing system of CO2 capture/release.
